# LibreDWG Source Manifest

Source status: NOT_READY

The current checked-in `CLibreDWG.xcframework` does not yet have a recorded upstream commit in this repository. Do not ship this artifact until it has been rebuilt from a pinned LibreDWG source checkout and this manifest has been regenerated with `Source status: READY`.

## Required Ready Fields

The rebuild script must record these fields before release:

- Upstream repository
- Upstream commit
- Upstream describe
- Build script
- Build command
- Local patches
- Generated compatibility header
- Generated artifact

## How To Make This Ready

```sh
scripts/cad/build_libredwg_ios_xcframework.sh
scripts/release/check_libredwg_gpl_compliance.sh
scripts/release/package_corresponding_source.sh
```

After rebuilding, this file should be regenerated by the build script and should no longer contain `NOT_READY`.
